# Nimble Data Processing Terms (demo mirror)

Illustrative content for the Night's Watch hackathon demo. Not Nimble's actual terms.

Last updated: 2026-06-01

## Scope

These terms describe how Nimble processes customer data on behalf of its customers when providing its web data collection platform.

## Use of customer data

We use customer data only to run the collection jobs our customers configure. We do not use customer data to train machine learning or AI models.

## Retention

Customer data is deleted within 30 days of account termination. Tax and invoice records are retained for 7 years as required by law.

## Security

We encrypt customer data in transit and at rest and review access rights every quarter. We train our support staff on data protection every year.

## Changes to sub-processors

We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor. The current list is always available on our sub-processors page.
